  } catch (detectError) {}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
